text:
- Save it for later. Defer an unread comic in one Reading List without moving it or marking it read. Review deferred comics and resume whenever you are ready.
- Share the order, not your private notes. Export an unread reading order with source credits and official links, without personal history or availability choices.
- Make your own checklist. Preview a plain-text export, choose checkboxes or bullets, and decide whether to include descriptions, collected editions, links or notes.
- Find your next deep dive. New Comic Book Herald guides cover Doctor Octopus, Emma Frost, Vision, Mephisto, Ultron, Bucky Barnes, Sam Wilson, Miles Morales, Spider-Gwen and Spider-Man 2099, plus Donny Cates across Marvel.
- Keep source credits in sight. Reading List tiles, previews and reading views make the original guide easier to find.
- Get to the point. Shorter synopsis confirmations keep the important choices clear.
- Upgrade with care. Your saved progress carries forward, and older backups still work. Export a JSON backup first, then stay on version 3 or later: older versions cannot safely edit the new saved choices.
